about: Every word a visitor can read on the site. It lives here once. Most of it is Brandon's own copy from his 2025 version of this project. Use each string exactly as written. Add no new copy without logging it. No em dashes anywhere.

hero.headline: Where your work-life balance goes to die, beautifully.
hero.subline: We've perfected the art of making simple things unnecessarily complicated.
hero.sublineLong: We've perfected the art of making simple things unnecessarily complicated, and we're looking for people who appreciate that level of commitment to mediocrity.
hero.underCta: Est. time: 5 minutes · Satisfaction: Not guaranteed

perks.heading: Benefits That Sound Too Good To Be True
perks.subline: Because they probably are. We've included the fine print for free.

items.title: Unlimited PTO
items.promise: Take as many days off as you want!
items.finePrint: People who use it tend to get 'restructured' pretty quickly.

items.title: Flexible Hours
items.finePrint: Start between 8:00-8:15 AM. Leave when your manager leaves. (Never.)

items.title: Health Benefits
items.finePrint: Free meditation app. Premium features cost extra.

items.title: Growth Opportunities
items.finePrint: Responsibilities grow. Title and pay? We'll circle back.

items.title: Work-Life Balance
items.finePrint: All 'optional' team events are Saturday mornings.

items.title: Remote Friendly
items.promise: Work from anywhere in the world!
items.finePrint: If you're available 24/7 and reply to messages in 3 min.

items.title: Amazing Culture
items.finePrint: The kind that argues at Thanksgiving and avoids real issues.

perks.closing: Still interested? Either you didn't read the fine print, or you're exactly the kind of team player we're looking for.

awards.heading: Awards We Definitely Earned
awards.subline: Industry recognition that speaks for itself. Quietly. In a room by itself.

items.title: Top Employer
items.finePrint: Of companies we compared ourselves to

items.title: Most Transparent Company
items.finePrint: Transparent about our lack of transparency

awards.footnote: All awards verified by our legal team (they said "technically not false")

items.quote: I came for the unlimited PTO. I stayed because my badge stopped working and I couldn't leave the building.
They told me I'd wear many hats. They weren't lying. I was also the hat.
I learned more in three weeks here than I did in four years of college. Mostly about labor laws and my rights as an employee.
The culture here is unlike anything I've ever experienced. I say that as both a compliment and a warning.

items.role: Former Director of Doing More With Less
items.quote: Work-life balance isn't a myth here. It's more of a legend. Something people whisper about but no one's actually seen.
items.note: [ADDENDUM: They found the legend. It was dead.]

items.quote: This job taught me that 'fast-paced environment' is HR code for 'we haven't hired enough people.' Invaluable insight.

comparison.heading: Us vs. Functional Employers
comparison.subline: A fair and balanced comparison. (We wrote it.)

process.heading: Your Journey to Disappointment™
process.subline: Five simple steps. Endless opportunities for regret.

items.title: Find Our Job Posting
items.body: You clicked a link. That was your first mistake. There's no going back now.

items.title: Question Everything
items.body: Is this real? Should I apply? What is the meaning of work? All valid questions. None will be answered.

items.title: 47 Mandatory Assessments
items.body: Personality, skills, blood type, credit score, childhood trauma. The usual pre-screening.

items.title: The Waiting Period
items.body: 6-8 business months. Your application is very important to us. Please hold.

items.title: Professional Ghosting
items.body: We'll be in touch.™ (We won't. But the automated rejection email is beautifully designed.)

faq.heading: Questions We'd Rather You Not Ask
faq.subline: But since you're going to anyway, here are some pre-written deflections.

items.a: Define 'real.' Define 'job.' Actually, don't. Just apply and find out. Or don't. We're not your career counselor.
Competitive.™ We've compared our salaries to unpaid internships in 2003 and adjusted for inflation (downward). You'll be thrilled to learn you'll make money. Some of it.
You probably shouldn't. And yet, here you are, reading a FAQ on a satirical job application. That tells us everything we need to know about your decision-making skills. You'll fit right in.

Absolutely! Work from anywhere in the world, as long as you're available 24/7, respond to messages within 3 minutes, and your 'anywhere' is within a 15-minute commute of the office for 'occasional' in-person syncs.

No. Unlike actual corporations, we have no interest in your data, your browsing habits, or selling your information to third parties. Everything stays in your browser. We couldn't monetize you even if we wanted to. (We don't.)
That depends entirely on your current employment situation. If you're job hunting, it's either cathartic or triggering. If you're happily employed, it's hilarious. If you're in HR, it's 'concerning.'

Open Door Policy* (*door removed, frame remains)

Free Lunch: There Isn't One. Literally.

finalCta.heading: Ready to Waste Some Time?
finalCta.body: You've scrolled this far. Might as well see what all the fuss is about. Zero positions available. Maximum chaos guaranteed.
finalCta.underCta: 5 minutes of your life you'll never get back

footer.tagline: Making simple things unnecessarily complicated since 2024.
footer.bottom: If you're reading this, you've scrolled to the absolute bottom. Impressive commitment. We'd hire you, but we're not hiring. We're not even a real company. But if we were, you'd definitely be on the shortlist for our "Professional Footer Reader" position.
footer.plotTwist: Plot twist: This isn't real. It's a portfolio piece disguised as corporate hell. No data collected. No jobs available. No HR department to complain to.
